steps.js: app.S.active = 4; app.refreshUI(); app.setGizmo('rotate'); app.setGizmoJoint(false); document.getElementById('rightCol').style.visibility = 'hidden'; let at = 0; window.__rot = (deg) => { const { gizmo, gzProxy } = app, Q = gzProxy.quaternion.constructor, V = gzProxy.up.constructor, a = -(deg - at) * Math.PI / 180; at = deg; gizmo.dispatchEvent({ type: 'dragging-changed', value: true }); gzProxy.quaternion.premultiply(new Q().setFromAxisAngle(new V(0, 0, 1), a)); gizmo.dispatchEvent({ type: 'objectChange' }); gizmo.dispatchEvent({ type: 'dragging-changed', value: false }); window.__caption('Rotate (E): ' + Math.round(deg) + '\u00b0') }
